turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here is one example, step by step.
I have ___ pen. Step 1: look at the first sound of "pen". It is "p". Step 2: "p" is not a vowel sound, so I use "a". I have a pen.
Rule: say the next word; a vowel sound takes "an", other sounds take "a".
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: I have an pen.
Now try this one. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
